新增:
桌面小部件
热议话题、帖子榜、吧动态、常逛的吧，以及热议与常逛。吧动态可选最新、热门或精华，并能直接签到；在「设置 → 通用 → 桌面小部件」中编辑或添加

签到进度
一键签到时，首页的签到按钮显示进度，签好的吧随即打勾

系统助手
支持 App Functions 的系统助手可以查看热议话题和帖子榜、搜索和阅读帖子、查看关注的吧；屏蔽的内容同样不会出现

拖放图片
长按图片后拖动，可把原图拖到其他应用；拖到回复框的图片会加入回复

键盘与鼠标
右键打开长按菜单，指针悬停时有反馈；支持返回、搜索、刷新、逐条浏览、翻页和发送回复的快捷键，按 Meta + / 查看全部；滚轮缩放图片

新窗口
平板或分屏时，可从帖子的菜单在新窗口中打开帖子；桌面模式下以浮动窗口打开

错误记录
「设置 → 通用 → 问题排查」新增「错误记录」，遇到奇怪的错误时可查看详情并发送
改进:
长按菜单
帖子的长按菜单与 ⋮ 菜单一致，常用操作排成一排；预览占据更多空间，平板上菜单放在预览旁边

触感
拖动越过松手即生效的位置时，有一下轻微的震动

正文行距
帖子正文的行距统一为字号的 1.45 倍，各种手机上一致

帖子时间
吧内按发帖时间排序时，帖子显示发帖时间，与排列顺序一致

置顶帖
展开和收起置顶帖使用同一个按钮

搜索
通过回复搜到的帖子，显示其中含关键词的回复；下拉刷新时保留已有结果
修复: 搜索 c++ 或括号等符号时，应用崩溃
一键签到后，首页的已签标记要刷新才出现
在 HyperOS 上，未开启「桌面快捷方式」权限时，发送到桌面没有任何提示
平板分栏时，双击顶栏会让旁边一栏也回到顶部
平板上按住侧边导航时，旁边页面的文字跳动
展开的折叠屏或平板横屏时，图片说明偏到左侧

New:
Home screen widgets
Hot topics, the thread ranking, a forum, your forums, and hot topics with your forums. The forum widget shows the latest, hot or featured threads and signs you in right from it; edit or add them in Settings → General → Home screen widgets

Signing progress
While signing in to all forums, the sign-in button on Home shows the progress, and each forum is ticked as it is signed

System assistant
Assistants that support App Functions can see hot topics and the thread ranking, search and read threads, and list your forums; what you blocked stays out

Dragging pictures
Touch and hold a picture, then drag it to another app to give it the original; pictures dropped on the reply field join the reply

Keyboard and mouse
Right-click opens the long-press menu, and what the pointer is over shows it; shortcuts go back, search, refresh, move between items, page and send a reply, with Meta + / listing them all; the mouse wheel zooms pictures

New windows
On tablets or in split screen, open a thread in a new window from its menu; in desktop mode it opens as a floating window

Error records
Settings → General → Troubleshooting has Error records, with the details of an odd error to look at and send
Improved:
Long-press menus
A thread's long-press menu is the same as its ⋮ menu, with common actions in one row; the preview gets more room, and on tablets the menu sits beside it

Haptics
Dragging past the point where letting go takes effect gives a light tick

Line spacing
Post text is spaced at 1.45 times the font size, the same on every phone

Thread times
In a forum sorted by post time, threads show when they were posted, matching their order

Pinned threads
One button opens and folds the pinned threads

Search
A thread found by a reply in it shows that reply with the keyword; pulling to refresh keeps the results until new ones come
Fixed: Searching for c++ or a bracket crashed the app
After signing in to all forums, Home showed the ticks only after a refresh
On HyperOS, sending a forum to the home screen without the Home screen shortcuts permission failed without a word
In two panes on a tablet, a double tap on the top bar also scrolled the other pane to the top
On tablets, holding an item on the side navigation made the text of the page beside it jump
On an unfolded phone or a tablet held sideways, a picture's caption sat against the left edge
